locked_dimensions.note: extremes evaluated on the CAD faces (OCCT's optimal bounding box is only approximate on the left tip)

zebra.sampled: each join at native u in [1e-3, 1 - 1e-3] (collapsed LE/TE corners excluded), only where both faces face the camera (n.V < -0.05); gradient ratios use a floor of max(1% of the 95th-percentile gradient on that join, 1e-3 stripes/mm); crossing directions are compared only where both gradients exceed that floor
